crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your…
God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit…
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day…

translations.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
translations.bsb: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
translations.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name.
